ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $\angle AOB = 50^\circ$, $\angle BOC = 90^\circ$, and $OM$ and $ON$ are the angle bisectors of $\angle AOB$ and $\angle BOC$ respectively. What is the degree measure of $\angle MON$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle AOB=50^\circ$, and $OM$ is the angle bisector of $\angle AOB$,\\
$\therefore \angle BOM=25^\circ$.\\
Also, since $\angle BOC=90^\circ$, and $ON$ is the angle bisector of $\angle BOC$,\\
$\therefore \angle BON=45^\circ$.\\
$\therefore \angle MON=25^\circ+45^\circ=\boxed{70^\circ}$.
